source_contract.no_growth: Signed request clamp>=1 then signed current capacity comparison; no count/data read or allocator call when capacity suffices.
source_contract.allocation: Wrapping DWORD request*12 or request*4; fixed cdecl bridge to singleton_lifetime_allocate({object,bytes,bytes}). No allocator callback or overflow check.
source_contract.request_storage: B22B60 writes fresh allocation into actual [ESP+14] request slot; B22B97 reloads it after the loop. B236B0 does not overwrite its request. This is actual caller-prepared callee argument storage, not owner data.
source_contract.copy: Current count/base after allocation; current source base and signed count each iteration; native per-word loads/stores and null computed destination skip. Count is never written.
source_contract.publication: Read current old-data pointer after copying, call full fixed free bridge, then publish fresh data and captured capacity; preserve any current count from provider reentry.
source_contract.valid_domain: Actual header and all reached copy/publication accesses have valid extents/lifetimes for native wrapping arithmetic. Backing allocations use the existing shared malloc/free heap. No malformed-storage repair, ownership substitution or rollback.
